findings.issue: Same-day observed weather (temp, atemp, hum, windspeed, weather) is used as a predictor of same-day cnt. Not target leakage (check_identity on all 15 features: clean), but it assumes perfect weather knowledge at forecast time.
findings.why_it_matters: Reported valid/test scores are an upper bound relative to a real forecast that would only have a weather forecast; the write-up should state this assumption.

findings.issue: README says `make test` runs 14 tests; the suite actually runs 22 (22 passed).
findings.why_it_matters: Minor doc drift; a reader can't use the stated count to confirm the full suite ran.
